column1: # P/04 slot fate, N3 fate. Machine part slot-fate; core calls it.
# states: judge,alive,wait,hung,hung_moved,unsure,unsure_moved,move,release. Initial judge, all others terminal.
# A release action delegates CAS to slot-release; it does not grant permission from a mere selection. The two closing rules remain as in the source.
# Same machine grammar as P/03 slot-capture: literal TAB; first matching row for the current state wins; no match waits without an effect.
# Inputs are derived from complete reads by the source contracts. A non-answer/badkey is not absence and is not invented positive knowledge.
#var age double — seconds this judge has observed the SAME slot version; first sight/restart is zero, version change resets it. Never derive it from until or fates.since.
#var slot_readable bool — by the slot family; readable gen alone does not make a torn row readable.
#var worker_fresh bool — worker heartbeat version changed within the last LOST_AFTER, inclusive boundary.
#var resource string — live|unreachable|silent|unknown, by common/contracts/observation.md Resource state.
#var presence string — runs|gone|unlisted|unknown; use only from a live resource. An absent workers/running/unknown field is the empty list.
#var assigned bool — the slot's assignment has units.
#var server_known bool — server from heartbeat, otherwise Slot.server; neither available is false.
#var gen_readable bool — existing gen reads; never substitute zero to give a name or release.
#var version string — the exact slot version used in this judgement, not a later re-read.
#var HUNG_MOVE_AFTER double — effective controller setting from daemon-flags.tsv and the common env-file owner; all hung/unsure/wait limits count age from the same first observation.
#const SLOT_TERM double = 45.0 — common/contracts/slot.md Terms.
#const LOST_AFTER double = 45.0 — common/contracts/observation.md Freshness.
#action result(string,string) — return fate and permission version; empty version means no names_given entry. The wrapper publishes no permission after a refused write.
# action=- — YOURS at norm, must run before accepting the next event; never noop.
